panels.title: API-equivalent cost per hour: Manager vs agents

targets.queryText: select ts/3600*3600 as time, sum(case when agent_id is null then cost_usd else 0 end) as Manager, sum(case when agent_id is not null then cost_usd else 0 end) as Agents from message_costs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1
targets.rawQueryText: select ts/3600*3600 as time, sum(case when agent_id is null then cost_usd else 0 end) as Manager, sum(case when agent_id is not null then cost_usd else 0 end) as Agents from message_costs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Messages with an agent_id come from subagent transcripts; the rest are the main sessions. Not a bill: an estimate at pay-as-you-go API prices; the subscription is a flat fee.
